subject: Spatial lag model (slm) with panel data

messages.author: c4a3575d08613e47
messages.subject: Spatial lag model (slm) with panel data
parts:
Hi

I'm trying out the slm latent model, and i can't seem to make it work for my paneldata. I have 270 regions and observations for seven years for each. It works nicely if I look at one year only i.e. if I throw out 6 of the observations for each region. 

If i try it on the full dataset i get the error "Error: all(dim(args.slm$W) == c(slm.n, slm.n)) er ikke TRUE ". Which is not at all surprising since in my context it's clear that dim(W) != n, in fact dim(W) must be equal to n/7.

Am I missing something or is slm, for some reason, not compatible with paneldata?

Kind Regards
Claus Vestergaard, Aalborg, Denmark.
